method: Read actual exported HIGH/LOD triangles and embedded atlas. Select outward vertical blue facets larger than .003 square local units by their actual centroid texel; ray from their normal toward the geometry and sample first-hit texel. This scoped selection excludes tiny panes and canonical CC0 house, may include dark blue facade/roof details, and is an authoring observation rather than a pass/fail product test, all-opening guarantee, native filtering/FPS or artistic proof. No source/game/geometry mutation.
